Legend Maker

Released February 1, 2006 · 93 cards

Legend Maker is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on February 1, 2006. Its main set has 92 cards, plus 1 secret rare numbered beyond the set (93 in total). It includes 82 Pokémon, 9 Trainer and 2 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

29 illustrators worked on Legend Maker. Most cards: Ryo Ueda (11), Midori Harada (7), Mitsuhiro Arita (7), Atsuko Nishida (5), Hajime Kusajima (5), Kagemaru Himeno (5), Kouki Saitou (5), Tomokazu Komiya (5).
